title: Stale federation mailbox retry can surface 503 instead of terminal conflict under full-suite load
outcome: A stale mailbox capability remains terminally refused when unrelated persistence is settling during the Windows full suite; transient retryable persistence responses do not replace the captured stale-binding outcome.
acceptance: The cause of the full-suite 503 versus the isolated 409 is established with run evidence, and a correction preserves stale-binding refusal without retargeting the recreated recipient.
The focused regression and Windows full gate pass on the exact reviewed tree.
